note: RPC deviation rules used by the QCA DSM engine. Edit with the rule editor in the app (QCA DSM engine > RPC rule library), download, and upload this file to GitHub to change the rules for every user. Limits are % of the deviation base; X is the % of available capacity in that base: base = X% of AvC + (100 - X)% of scheduled generation.

rules.name: CERC DSM 2024 (available capacity)
rules.desc: Regulation 8(4) bands with deviation measured against available capacity (X = 100).

rules.name: Legacy ±15%
rules.desc: Older projects still settled on the earlier rule: 100% both ways up to 15% of AvC, beyond that shortfall 110% and excess 90%.

rules.name: CERC DSM 2024 with X factor
rules.desc: Same bands and rates as CERC DSM 2024, with deviation measured against X% of AvC + (100 - X)% of schedule. X per CERC order of 31 Mar 2026 for existing projects: 100 in 2026-27, 80 in 2027-28, 60, 40, 20, then 0 from 1 Apr 2031. Check the wind values against the order: CERC set separate paths for wind and solar.
